title: Industrial Chemical Technology I
mcq: Fill in the blank: ______ is the purification of substances by taking advantage of changes in solubility with respect to temperature.
Re-crystallisation
Thermal radiation
Membrane
Mass transfer
Re-crystallisation is the purification of substances by taking advantage of changes in solubility with respect to temperature.
Fill in the blank: ______ is defined as the transfer of thermal energy across a well-defined boundary around a thermodynamic system.
Mass transfer
Heat
Forced convection
Conduction
Heat is defined as the transfer of thermal energy across a well-defined boundary around a thermodynamic system.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the most significant means of heat transfer within a solid or between solid objects in thermal contact.
Heat transfer methods
Distillation
Crushers
Conduction
Conduction is the most significant means of heat transfer within a solid or between solid objects in thermal contact.

A membrane is any barrier which allows one substance to pass through it more than another.
Fill in the blank: ______ is the general practice of taking something liquid and forcing it to become dissolved in another liquid.

Conduction
Extraction
Extraction is the general practice of taking something liquid and forcing it to become dissolved in another liquid.
Fill in the blank: ______ is a machine designed to reduce large rocks into smaller rocks, gravel, or rock dust.

Crusher
A crusher is a machine designed to reduce large rocks into smaller rocks, gravel, or rock dust.

fib: ______ is the net movement of mass from one location, usually meaning a stream, phase, fraction or component, to another.
Mass transfer
Mass transfer is the net movement of mass from one location, usually meaning a stream, phase, fraction or component, to another.
______ is the transfer of energy through space by means of electromagnetic waves in much the same way as electromagnetic light waves transfer light.
Radiation
Radiation is the transfer of energy through space by means of electromagnetic waves in much the same way as electromagnetic light waves transfer light.
______ is a direct result of the random movements of atoms and molecules in matter.
Thermal radiation
Thermal radiation is a direct result of the random movements of atoms and molecules in matter.
______ is a point at which when the solution boils, the vapour has the same composition as the liquid.
azeotrope
An azeotrope is a point at which when the solution boils, the vapour has the same composition as the liquid.

______ are used in numerous disciplines, such as automotive engineering, thermal management of electronic devices and systems, climate control, insulation, materials processing, and power plant engineering.
Heat transfer methods

Heat transfer methods are used in numerous disciplines, such as automotive engineering, thermal management of electronic devices and systems, climate control, insulation, materials processing, and power plant engineering.
______ is an idealised reactor in which the reactants are dumped in one large tank, allowed to react, and then the products (and unused reactants) are released out of the bottom.
continuous stirred-tank reactor

A continuous stirred-tank reactor is an idealised reactor in which the reactants are dumped in one large tank, allowed to react, and then the products (and unused reactants) are released out of the bottom.
______ refers to the induced motion of a material in a specified way, usually in a circulatory pattern inside some sort of container.
Agitation
Agitation refers to the induced motion of a material in a specified way, usually in a circulatory pattern inside some sort of container.
______ is a quantitative, vectorial representation of the heat flow through a surface.
Heat flux
Heat flux is a quantitative, vectorial representation of the heat flow through a surface.
______ is a (idealised) reactor in which the reacting fluid flows through a tube at a rapid pace, but without the formation of eddies characteristic of rapid flow.
plug flow reactor
A plug flow reactor is a (idealised) reactor in which the reacting fluid flows through a tube at a rapid pace, but without the formation of eddies characteristic of rapid flow.
______ is the most widely used separation process in the chemical industry.
Distillation
Distillation is the most widely used separation process in the chemical industry.
